native_rule.creator: yugandhar.mocherla@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.description: This rule detects the Active Directory query tool, AdFind.exe. AdFind has legitimate purposes, but it is frequently leveraged by threat actors to perform post-exploitation Active Directory reconnaissance. The AdFind tool has been observed in Trickbot, Ryuk, Maze, and FIN6 campaigns.
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] AdFind Command Activity
native_rule.s1ql: endpoint.os = 'windows' (src.process.name = 'adfind.exe' OR src.process.image.path contains 'adfind.exe' or cmdScript.content contains 'adfind.exe') (event.type='Command\ Script' OR event.type='process creation')
